content: WCAG 2.2 requires text alternatives for non-text content, sufficient text contrast, resize/reflow, keyboard operability, visible focus, usable target sizes, and mechanisms to pause or stop automatic movement and updates. W3C guidance also recommends honoring reduced-motion preferences and avoiding unnecessary motion. For a pixel-art simulation, accessible dialogue/transcripts, semantic controls outside the canvas, keyboard navigation, readable scaling, pause, reduced motion, and non-color status cues belong in launch scope.
